The equilibrium constants of the following reactions are
$A_2 + 3B_2 \\rightleftharpoons 2AB_3 : K_1$
$A_2 + C_2 \\rightleftharpoons 2AC : K_2$

explanation:

question_text: In a hypothetical condition, if a polysaccharide was made using 20 glucose molecules then, how many water molecules will be produced in dehydration synthesis of this compound and what will be its molecular formula respectively?
explanation:
1. For $n$ monomers, $n-1$ water molecules are released during dehydration synthesis. For 20 glucose molecules, $20-1 = 19$ $H_2O$ molecules are produced.
2. Total atoms in 20 glucose ($C_6H_{12}O_6$): $C = 120, H = 240, O = 120$.
3. Subtract 19 $H_2O$: $H = 240 - (19 \	imes 2) = 202$; $O = 120 - 19 = 101$.
Resulting formula: $C_{120}H_{202}O_{101}$.
